paragraphs: Markets over the last day: the eight tracked equity indices moved -0.37% on average, with Hang Seng strongest (+0.49%) and Nikkei 225 weakest (-2.42%). Brent crude changed -1.44% to 94.46. Gold changed -0.35% to 3,872.6001. Bitcoin changed -1.74% to 64,166.1992. The US 10-year yield stands at 5.154%, a relative move of +1.00%. Among the firms tracked, Invesco (+2.35%) and Freeport-McMoRan (-2.00%) moved the most.
